{{Top|leg}}
The '''South Market''' was a marketplace that mainly dealt to the affluent tastes of the [[Stones-dweller|Stone-dwellers]]. It was not as crowded as the [[North Market]], and the clientele was more upscale. [[Hahz Fallone]] had many supporters in this area.<ref name="The Black Sphere">{{WEGCite|story=The Black Sphere|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
